title: The Senior officer of the ship
subtitle: 服务职业 · 主题语境阅读
theme: 服务职业（人与社会·社会服务与人际沟通·服务行业与职业）
meta: 主题语境：服务职业（人与社会·社会服务与人际沟通·服务行业与职业）　|　核心词汇：senior　|　正文 344 words　|　高三一轮复习
intro: 请阅读文章，根据上下文判断每一处 senior 的用法与含义，再完成 Task 1—Task 3。
passage: In 1976 the shopkeeper wrote of ① a senior officer of the ship in the account, and everybody in the shop said at once that it was ② so senior that nobody in the shop would go near it. Three months on, people still spoke of that morning, and of how the shopkeeper, who never explained anything, had done it without a word of thanks and gone home; it was the senior ones, my mother said, that people remembered longest.

It was ③ the senior officer of the ship that anybody there had ever seen, or so the account for July 1970 claims. My mother, who had seen them all, thought it ④ too senior to be of any use to anybody, and said as much to the buyer who had come to help; the senior ones, she used to say, were never the useful ones.

My uncle, who kept the scale at the far counter, meant something else entirely. He called the whole business ⑤ a senior member of the club, and said that no buyer in his right mind would call it ⑥ as senior as the member of the club they had once had in the old shop. He was never a man who cared whether a thing was senior or not, and he said so.

By 1983 the matter had shrunk to half a line in the account. What the line asked for was ⑦ something senior, and nothing besides. The buyer from the next shop called the whole plan ⑧ quite senior; everybody laughed, and then did exactly what he had said. After that the account kept the names of the senior ones only.

My mother said nothing at all. In 1986, at once, she wrote of another senior officer of the ship in the same account, and the work, which took two months, seemed ⑨ no less senior than anybody had expected. ⑩ The senior member of the club that nobody had wanted to name, she said in 1988, was the one she could never quite name; the senior ones, she added, are always the ones that stay.

task1.title: Task 1　语境辨义
task1.intro: 请为文中十处画线形式选择对应的用法说明。
options: A. adj. 高级（前置定语 a senior officer of the ship：1976 年掌柜在账本里记下的那件高级的船员）
B. adj. 高级／资深（两处加强说法：so senior that … 与 no less senior than …）
C. adj. 高级／资深（两处定语从句式的最高级说法，见第 3、10 题）
D. adj. 高级（表语 too senior to do：母亲觉得它太高级，反倒派不上用场）
E. adj. 资深（前置定语 a senior member of the club：叔叔把整件事称作一桩资深的成员）
F. adj. 资深（同级比较 as senior as：拿眼前这桩跟旧日那桩俱乐部的资深成员相比）
G. adj. 资深（后置定语 something senior：修饰不定代词时须放在其后）
H. adj. 资深（受程度副词修饰 quite senior：那位买主的评价）

items.q: a senior officer of the ship
the senior officer of the ship that
a senior member of the club
The senior member of the club that

answers.why: senior 意为“高级”，1976 年掌柜在账本里记下的是“一件高级的船员”，此处作前置定语 a senior officer of the ship。
senior 意为“高级”，此处用 so senior that 结构，说它高级到铺子里没人敢靠近。
senior 意为“高级”，账本上 七月 那行字说那是当地人从未见过的高级船上的高级船员，等于最高级的说法。
senior 意为“高级”，母亲认为这件东西“太高级了，谁也用不上”，too senior to do 表示“太……以致不能”。
senior 意为“资深”，叔叔把整件事称作“一桩资深的成员”，此处作前置定语 a senior member of the club。
senior 意为“资深”，叔叔不肯说它“跟旧日那桩俱乐部的资深成员一样资深”，同级比较用 as senior as。
senior 意为“资深”，账本上那半行字要的是“资深的东西”，something 被形容词修饰时形容词须后置：something senior。
senior 意为“资深”，邻铺子来的那位买主认为这套计划“相当资深”，quite 修饰原级 senior。
senior 意为“资深”，no less senior than 表示“其资深不亚于……”，此处说这趟活儿之资深不亚于任何人的预料。
senior 意为“资深”，母亲 1988 年说的是“那桩她始终叫不出名字的资深成员”，that 从句限定到极致。

task2.title: Task 2　语境运用
task2.intro: 请把下列句子译成英文，括号里是必须用到的形式。
items: 1976 年，掌柜在账本里记下了一件高级的船员。（a senior officer of the ship）
它高级到铺子里没有一个人敢靠近。（so senior that …）
母亲觉得它太高级，谁也用不上。（too senior to …）
叔叔把整件事称作一桩资深的成员。（a senior member of the club）
他说，谁也不会认为它跟旧日那桩俱乐部的资深成员一样资深。（as senior as …）
到了 1983 年，账本上只剩半行字：要的是一件资深的东西。（something senior）
answers: In 1976 the shopkeeper wrote of a senior officer of the ship in the account.
It was so senior that nobody in the shop would go near it.
My mother thought it too senior to be of any use to anybody.
My uncle called the whole business a senior member of the club.
He said nobody would call it as senior as the member of the club they had once had.
By 1983 the account asked for nothing but something senior.

task3.title: Task 3　语境写作
task3.intro: 请写 5—6 个句子，至少使用 senior 的 3 种不同用法（前置定语、表语、比较级／最高级、后置定语等）；至少使用下列词语中的 3 个。
answers: In 1976 the shopkeeper wrote of a senior officer of the ship in the account, and nobody forgot it.
It was the senior officer of the ship that anybody there had ever seen, or so the account says.
My mother thought it too senior to be of any use, and said so plainly.
My uncle called the whole business a senior member of the club, and nobody argued with him.
The buyer from the next shop called the plan quite senior, and everybody laughed.
The senior ones, my mother said, are always the ones that stay.
